---
title: "Blog"

# Year headings are not linkable sections, so suppress Quarto's hover anchor links.
# This also keeps the emitted class attribute exactly "archive-year".
anchor-sections: false

listing:
  id: archive
  contents: posts/**/*.qmd
  template: ejs/archive.ejs
  sort: "date desc"
  page-size: 0
  feed: true
---
